propositions: Infrastructure changes that introduce runtime-only correctness risks (boot failures, credential authorization, dependency connectivity, readiness checks) are currently discovered only at the end of slow delivery cycles, with no criterion incentivizing front-loaded validation.

T15 overlay requires that risky mechanisms be proven via fast out-of-loop experiments (local/emulated runs or manual probes against real targets) before committing them into slow automated pipelines, conditional on applicability checks (codified loop, slow/costly pass, runtime-only correctness).

A passing T15 plan must name the specific risky mechanism, commit to a concrete fast proof experiment returning a verdict in minutes, ensure the experiment runs before loop commitment, and clean up only artifacts the experiment itself created.
T10's rubric must be partitioned to exclude transient de-risk experiments from its durable infrastructure scope, ensuring no runtime criterion suppression overlap between T10 and T15.
T15 guidance must be integrated into rebar's criterion registry, documentation regeneration, and the writing-a-passing-plan author guide.
